title: Scrambled eggs with smoked salmon
subtitle: Soft-set eggs with cold-smoked salmon and chives
excerpt: Very slowly scrambled eggs, silky and soft, served with cold-smoked salmon and buttered toast. A luxurious breakfast that takes under 10 minutes.
sourceNotes: Scrambled eggs with smoked salmon is a British and American classic breakfast and brunch dish. The slow-scramble technique is associated with Gordon Ramsay's well-known demonstration; the egg-to-cream ratio and method are standard across classic references.

content.text: The slow scramble is the right method here. Eggs cooked in a hot pan produce rubbery, dry curds. Cooked over medium-low heat with butter, stirring constantly and moving the pan on and off the heat, the eggs form into large, silky folds. The smoked salmon goes on cold alongside or just folded through at the very end. Neither method is wrong.
Crack the eggs into a saucepan. Add the butter and place over medium-low heat. Stir continuously with a rubber spatula, scraping the bottom and sides of the pan.

Every 20 to 30 seconds, lift the pan off the heat and continue stirring for a few seconds to slow the cooking. The eggs will begin to form into large, soft, glossy curds. This process takes 5 to 7 minutes and should not be rushed.

When the eggs are just set but still very slightly undercooked-looking, remove from heat immediately. Stir in the cream or crème fraîche, which stops the cooking and adds richness. Season with salt and pepper.
Spoon onto buttered toast. Lay the smoked salmon alongside or fold it through the eggs. Scatter with chives and a grinding of black pepper. Serve immediately.

items.symptom: The eggs are dry and rubbery
items.cause: Cooked too fast or too long
items.fix: Start again over lower heat. The eggs must never fully set in the pan; they finish cooking on the plate.

items.symptom: The eggs are watery and loose
items.fix: Return to the heat briefly, stirring. They should hold their shape when spooned.
Season generously at the end. Use the best fresh eggs you can find; they make a visible difference.

items.symptom: The salmon is warm and slightly cooked
items.cause: Added too early while the eggs were still on the heat
items.fix: Add the smoked salmon only after plating, or fold through at the very last moment off the heat.

content.text: Scrambled eggs with smoked salmon is a weekend breakfast and brunch staple in Britain, associated with celebrations, Christmas morning, and leisurely Sundays. The quality of both ingredients matters: free-range eggs with deep-orange yolks, and good cold-smoked Scottish salmon. It is also one of the standard breakfast items in hotel dining rooms, where it is unfortunately often overcooked. Made properly at home, it takes 10 minutes and produces something quietly excellent.
